name: workbench
description: Codex-ready PR-filing, goal-handoff, claim-check, qa-sweep, empirical-proof, code-quality-review, get-pr-comments, route-work, and fix-ci skills, the workbench process skills (audit, brainstorming, TDD, systematic-debugging, verification-before-completion, receiving-code-review, using-workbench; derived from obra/superpowers, MIT), and bundled agent files (reviewers + ci-watcher) from Agent Workshop.

interface.shortDescription: Workflow, review, and workbench process skills for Codex.
interface.longDescription: A Codex manifest for the Agent Workshop workbench plugin. Codex exposes the file-pr, handoff-goal, claim-check, qa-sweep, empirical-proof, code-quality-review, get-pr-comments, route-work, and fix-ci skills plus the workbench process set (audit, brainstorming, test-driven-development, systematic-debugging, verification-before-completion, receiving-code-review, using-workbench) from this package; the agent files (the reviewers plus ci-watcher) are bundled in the payload for Claude Code and reference, but Codex standalone custom agents still need repo-local .codex/agents wrappers.
defaultPrompt: File the branch's PR and see it through to green and mergeable.
Investigate whether a ticket or claim still holds.
Run a team-scale QA sweep over a release and corroborate the findings.
Empirically prove a just-finished change at the running app.
Run a strict code quality review on the current branch.
Summarize the active PR's review comments into a prioritized action list.
Recommend a model and effort route for a task before dispatching it.
Watch the current branch's CI and fix whatever breaks.
Audit something: size the workload, run the right engine, confirm the flags.
Brainstorm a feature or refactor design before building it.
Explain how to install reviewer agents for Codex.
